language.systemNotReady: system is set to {name} - not translated yet, so English is shown

coverage.sub: counted from the bundled message files
coverage.contributeHint: Translations live in deliverer/src/locales - one folder per language, one JSON file per page. A language switches on once its coverage is real.

formats.regionHint: Drives number separators and regional-style dates and times.

notifications.title: While crawling in background
notifications.sub: what Curio shows when another app is in front

mini.label: Mini window
mini.desc: floating panel over other apps · workers, progress, Pause all

notify.label: Notifications
notify.desc: one system notification when a run finishes · tray icon shows progress

none.label: Nothing
none.desc: stay quiet · check Pipeline when you come back

notifications.miniUnsupported: not supported on this desktop (Wayland) · needs X11 / XWayland
notifications.miniHint: Appears 1.5 s after Curio loses focus while a worker runs, over every other app; drag it anywhere and it snaps to the nearer screen edge. × hides it until the queue empties; the tray menu brings it back.
notifications.notifyHint: One system notification per finished run - “Ganyu · pixiv · +38 new” - and nothing else. The first one asks the system for permission.
notifications.noneHint: No window, no notification. The tray icon stays, without progress.
notifications.startExpandedHint: all workers and the queue, not just the focused one
notifications.trayKeepsHint: after ×, the tray tooltip still shows posts / target
notifications.coerced: On Linux Wayland the {mini} option is disabled (the compositor won’t keep a window on top) and the setting falls back to {notify}.
notifications.browserNote: The mini window and the tray icon need the desktop app; in the browser this setting has no effect.

status.savedNextJob: saved · applies to the next job

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.local: your login stays on this computer
accounts.intro: Curio browses pixiv and X as you, the way your browser does. Signing in happens on the site's own page - Curio never sees your password. pixiv is required for finding artworks; X is optional and adds the artists' own posts.
accounts.skipped: You skipped this at first launch; signing in here does the same thing.

theme.title: Theme
theme.intro: pick a preset or build your own · applies across the whole app

custom.title: Custom theme
custom.hint: edits the selected preset · save it to keep it
custom.importHint: paste a theme exported from Curio
custom.badJson: that is not a Curio theme
custom.name: Name

window.title: Background opacity
window.hint: how the canvas sits under the plates
window.transparentHint: Lets the desktop show through the window instead of a solid fill.
window.blurHint: Frosts whatever is behind the window. Costs a little GPU on large libraries.
window.desktopOnly: the desktop frost needs the desktop app; the browser build blurs the plates only

preview.title: Live preview
preview.hint: Drawn with the draft theme at the current opacity and blur over live artwork.

storage.title: Storage
storage.versions: app {app} · daemon dawnmaker v{daemon} · schema v{schema}
storage.hint: The database never lives inside the library folder - moving the library to a synced drive is safe; the db is not.
storage.byCharacterValue: 0 characters · 0 B extra | 1 character · 0 B extra | {n} characters · 0 B extra
storage.trashEmptied: 0 images removed | 1 image removed | {n} images removed

network.title: Network
network.resolverDoh: doh - DNS over HTTPS (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8 by IP)
network.resolverHint: Layer 1 of the bypass: names resolve over HTTPS to an IP endpoint, so ISP DNS hijack is skipped. TLS still verifies the real hostname.
network.proxyHint: Layer 2, for SNI/DPI blocks. Also passed to gallery-dl. Certificate verification is never disabled - a proxy that needs that is an interceptor.
network.rateHint: Conservative on purpose - this is a private archive, not a mirror.
network.xSearchOff: off - X never searches, only follows linked artists
network.xSearchHint: For crawls started from the command line. Crawls from the app search until each character's “Posts per run”. Search is the request X rate-limits and suspends for. 0 turns X search off everywhere.

duplicates.title: Duplicates
duplicates.hint: Exact sha256 always dedupes. Near-duplicates compare within the same artist only - cross-artist matches are far more often two people drawing the same pose than one repost. 6 is conservative; above 10 starts merging variants.
duplicates.ruleScore: Throw away when the character's score is below
duplicates.ruleOther: Throw away images identified as another character
duplicates.ruleHint: The same criteria as a gallery's Smart deletion, judged as each image is stored. Near-duplicates are already caught by the distance above; the images a character has not been identified against yet are kept.

about.title: About
about.name: Curio
about.blurb: A private archive. Attribution is kept on every record; nothing here is meant to be redistributed.

characters.title: New characters
characters.lead: What a new character's form starts with. Each character can change it in its own form.
characters.kindsHint: Two small classifiers judge each image as it is stored; a real photo - a cosplayer, a figure, a person - is rejected before it reaches the archive, as are 3D renders and UI screenshots. Only illustrations and anime screencaps are kept. Off keeps every image and labels it instead, so the gallery's Show row can still filter them.
characters.identify: Name the character in every image
characters.identifyHint: Two taggers name who is in each kept image - any anime, game, manga or novel character they know. Unsure pictures are marked unidentified; nothing is removed. The first run downloads up to ~1.3 GB.

backup.title: Backup
backup.sub: the whole archive as one file

export.title: Export
export.curioHint: Curio's own container. Every entry is hashed; a truncated copy still yields what is intact, damage is reported per entry.
export.zipHint: Opens anywhere. Images stored as-is; only the database and settings are deflated.
export.imagesHint: off = database + settings only; an import then re-downloads every image
export.secretsHint: anyone holding the file can use the session
export.browserHint: no save dialog here: the file is written under ~/.reaver/exports

import.title: Import
import.lead: Merge into this archive, or restore and replace it. You decide after the bundle is read.
import.pathHint: a path on the machine running the daemon · .curio or .zip

errors.busy_detail: pause it and let it drain, then import again

import.result: {characters} characters · {posts} posts · {placed} images placed · {dupes} duplicates · {refetch} to re-download
import.damagedNote: 0 damaged entries skipped | 1 damaged entry skipped | {n} damaged entries skipped

sheet.title: Import
sheet.noImages: This bundle has no images. Every post's images will be re-downloaded.
sheet.mergeHint: posts and images added, never duplicated; near-duplicates per artist
sheet.restoreHint: everything here is replaced by the bundle
sheet.settingsRestore: Settings · the bundle's are taken on restore
sheet.takeHint: daemon config, theme, language, notification mode
sheet.secrets: Take the bundle's pixiv session cookie
sheet.salvage: If some entries are damaged, import what is intact
sheet.salvageHint: a damaged image is re-downloaded on the next crawl; a damaged database refuses the import either way
sheet.gate: The pipeline must be paused and empty before an import.
sheet.importing: importing… the window will not respond until it is done
